fields.name: Full name
fields.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. An easy-to-remember phrase works well.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.lead: 30-day trial with every feature. No card needed.
signUp.terms: By creating your account you accept the {{terms}} and the {{privacy}}.
signUp.checkBody: We sent a link to {{email}} to confirm it's yours. Open it to activate your account.
signUp.checkSpam: Didn't get it? Check your spam folder or send it again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.unverified: Confirm your email before signing in. We sent you a new link.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to create a new password.
forgot.sent: If there's an account with that email, you'll get a link in a few minutes. It expires in 1 hour.

reset.title: Create a new password
reset.done: Done. You can now sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidLink: The link isn't valid or has expired. Request a new one.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.body: Open the link we sent you to activate your account.
verify.resent: We sent you a new link.
verify.failed: The link isn't valid or has expired.

invitation.title: You've been invited to a board
invitation.signInFirst: Sign in or create your account with {{email}} to accept it.
invitation.googleRequired: Editors sign in with their Google account. Continue with Google using {{email}}.
invitation.accepted: Done. You now have access to the board.
invitation.invalid: The invitation isn't valid, was already used or has expired.
invitation.wrongEmail: This invitation is for a different email. Sign in with {{email}}.

dashboard.title: Hi, {{name}}
dashboard.lead: Your dashboard is being set up. Soon you'll see your boards and upcoming appointments here.

altcha.label: I'm not a robot
altcha.expired: Verification expired. Please check it again.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: You're offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalid_format: Enter a valid email, for example name@domain.com.
errors.disposable: Use a permanent email; temporary addresses aren't accepted.
errors.no_mail_server: That email's domain doesn't receive mail. Check that it's spelled correctly.
errors.user_already_exists: There's already an account with that email. Sign in or reset your password.
errors.invalid_email_or_password: The email or password doesn't match.
errors.email_not_verified: Confirm your email before signing in. We sent you a new link.
errors.password_too_short: Your password must be at least 12 characters.
errors.password_too_long: Your password can be at most 128 characters.
errors.password_compromised: That password has appeared in data breaches. Choose another one.
errors.invalid_token: The link isn't valid or has expired.
errors.altcha_required: Check “I'm not a robot” and wait for it to verify.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.

consent.title: {{app}} wants to access your account
consent.note: It will act with your permissions. You can revoke it anytime in Dashboard → AI.
consent.invalid: The request is invalid or expired. Connect again from the app.
consent.error: We couldn't complete the connection. Try again.
